events.event_name: Scoop the City Ice Cream Truck Tour
events.address: Mobile route; see dated occurrence details
events.what_it_is: A two-day mobile ice cream truck tour through neighborhoods highlighted by Piece of Cake Moving and StreetEasy's 2026 NYC neighborhood data.
events.what_is_free: Free ice cream treats are advertised at each stop, plus chances to enter giveaways for Knicks tickets, restaurant gift cards, MTA passes, merchandise and other NYC prizes.
events.caveats: The truck moves between short timed stops. Free treats and giveaway items are subject to availability; arriving late to a stop may mean the truck has already moved on.
events.practical_notes: The official Piece of Cake page publishes exact stop-by-stop times for September 12 and 13. No RSVP, ticket or approval step is required.

events.address: North Esplanade by The Rink, 30 Rockefeller Plaza, New York, NY 10111
events.what_it_is: A NYFW Sally Hansen Miracle Gel Bold Glam activation at Rockefeller Center with nail touch-ups, photo moments and hands-on product experiences.
events.what_is_free: Public access to the activation, including the advertised nail touch-up and photo-moment experience.
events.caveats: The host confirms the activation and public Rockefeller Center setting. Individual services may be capacity-dependent during busy periods.
events.practical_notes: Sunday, September 13 runs 10 AM–6 PM at the North Esplanade by The Rink. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published.

events.event_name: Reese's × The Nitro Bar NYC Pop-Up
events.address: Astor Place Plaza, 26 Astor Place, New York, NY 10003
events.what_it_is: A two-day NYC debut pop-up for the Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Latte created with The Nitro Bar.
events.what_is_free: Up to 1,000 Reese's Pumpkins PB Whip Lattes are advertised for giveaway each day while supplies last. The first 100 fans in line each day can also receive a limited-edition Reese's × The Nitro Bar koozie, with additional Reese's candy and surprises advertised on site.
events.caveats: The official Hershey release confirms the September 14–15 NYC pop-up; the detailed giveaway quantities and Astor Place timing come from current local event reporting. Everything is while supplies last, so the activation can effectively end early for giveaways.
events.practical_notes: September 14 and 15 beginning at 11 AM at Astor Place Plaza. Current event listings say the activation runs until supplies last rather than to a guaranteed closing time.

events.address: The High Line above Little West 12th Street, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: Bvlgari's first U.S. public art installation: a monumental golden Serpenti-inspired pneumatic sculpture by Plastique Fantastique on the High Line.
events.what_is_free: Free public viewing of the High Line installation during park access hours; no ticket or RSVP is required for the outdoor artwork.
events.caveats: The installation is outdoors on the High Line and remains subject to park access, weather and any temporary park closures. Separate Bvlgari boutique appointments and jewelry experiences are not required to see the public sculpture.
events.practical_notes: On view September 10–20 above Little West 12th Street. Current sources describe the installation as free and open to the public; visit during High Line operating hours.
